text:
ITEM 1 | Leafy greens, dark green to yellow-green, wilted and glossy with moisture, folded in a loose heap with pale white-green stem pieces and leaf ribs, spanning roughly 12 x 13 cm on the left side of the plate, about 0.4 of plate area, soft and limp, no browning | 150
ITEM 2 | Cauliflower florets, cream to pale yellow with light golden-brown edges and small charred spots, bite-sized pieces about 2-3 cm each, slightly firm and dry-looking, clustered in the upper center of the plate, roughly 9 x 8 cm, about 0.1 of plate area | 90
ITEM 3 | Pale green sliced vegetable pieces, translucent edges with lighter core, soft and tender, cut into thick wedges about 4-5 cm long, one piece sitting among the cauliflower and greens near the top center | 30
ITEM 4 | Fish fillet portion, pinkish-orange flesh with a crust of flaked white-tan coating and sesame-like seeds on top, dry surface, flakes slightly visible at edges, about 6 x 4 cm and roughly 2 cm thick, sitting on the right side of the plate beside a dark green leaf | 110
ITEM 5 | Dark green leaf piece, glossy and slightly wilted, folded and flat, about 4 x 3 cm, lying next to the fish fillet on the right edge | 8
